name: LMS Messages
description: Notifies users of LMS events by creating Message entities (Message / Message Notify).
project_description:
Adds an ability to configure various automatic and manual messages that can be sent to LMS students and teachers by integrating Drupal LMS events with the Message module.

 Features 
 Additional Requirements 
 Message module

 Additional notes 
 Automation will keep failing and the module will not work as expected if Group Membership module is installed until https://www.drupal.org/project/grequest/issues/3507217 is handled (patch already included).
